study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
cohort: Singleton pregnancies complicated by preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) from the Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Network.
finding: In singleton pregnancies complicated by PPROM, there were no significant differences in pregnancy, neonatal, or long-term outcomes between infants delivered during the daytime versus nighttime.
